i.norm: When the unescaper is created with no OPTIONs it defaults to "semicolon required". The input begins with the hex entity prefix "&#x" but is not followed by any hex digits or a terminating semicolon, so it is not a valid numeric entity. As a result the translator leaves the input completely unchanged and returns it verbatim, including the seven trailing NUL ('�') padding characters of the backing array.
A 10-char buffer whose first three chars are the hex-entity prefix "&#x"; the remaining seven chars stay at their default value '�' (NUL).
Unchanged input: the "&#x" prefix followed by the seven default NUL chars.
